const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Visual, one-episode controller for the RoboCasa GR1 PnPCanToDrawerClose run.
+
+The controller uses only camera RGB/depth and the eef command/proprio channels
+returned by the standard client. Run in a Python process with one Robot client;
+the staged methods are intended to be called after inspecting each observation.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import pathlib
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+
+
+class Controller:
+    def __init__(self, robot, spec, out="/app/output/run"):
+        self.r = robot
+        self.spec = spec
+        self.out = pathlib.Path(out)
+        self.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        self.dt = float(spec["control_dt"])
+        self.cam_names = ["egoview", "robot0_agentview_center"]
+        self.obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=self.cam_names, include_depth=True, video="frames")
+        self.command = np.asarray(self.obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][80:104], dtype=np.float64)
+        self.obs.save(str(self.out / "observation_000"))
+        self.step = 0
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def world_to_base(p):
+        # Fixed GR1 base pose supplied by the service.
+        R = np.array([[0., -1., 0.], [1., 0., 0.], [0., 0., 1.]])
+        t = np.array([2.65, -2.175, 0.970])
+        return R.T @ (np.asarray(p, dtype=float) - t)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def pixel_to_world(u, v, depth, calibration):
+        K = np.asarray(calibration["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+        T = np.asarray(calibration["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
+        z = float(depth)
+        ray = np.array([(u - K[0, 2]) * z / K[0, 0],
+                        -(v - K[1, 2]) * z / K[1, 1], -z, 1.])
+        return (T @ ray)[:3]
+
+    def observe(self, label="observation"):
+        self.obs = self.r.get_obs(cameras=self.cam_names, include_depth=True, video="frames")
+        self.obs.save(str(self.out / f"{label}_{self.step:03d}"))
+        self.command = np.asarray(self.obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][80:104], dtype=np.float64)
+        return self.obs
+
+    def move(self, right=None, left=None, right_hand=None, left_hand=None,
+             seconds=1.5, label="move", cameras=None):
+        """Smooth absolute eef move; unchanged arm/hand targets are held."""
+        target = self.command.copy()
+        if right is not None:
+            target[0:6] = np.asarray(right, dtype=float)
+        if left is not None:
+            target[6:12] = np.asarray(left, dtype=float)
+        if right_hand is not None:
+            target[12:18] = np.asarray(right_hand, dtype=float)
+        if left_hand is not None:
+            target[18:24] = np.asarray(left_hand, dtype=float)
+        n = max(1, int(round(float(seconds) / self.dt)))
+        actions = np.linspace(self.command, target, n + 1, dtype=np.float64)[1:]
+        self.step += 1
+        cams = cameras or self.cam_names
+        result = self.r.submit("ee_pose", actions, dt=self.dt, interpolate="hold",
+                               cameras=cams, video_fps=5, video="frames",
+                               include_depth=True, note=label)
+        result.save(str(self.out / f"{label}_{self.step:03d}"))
+        self.command = target
+        self.obs = result
+        return result
+
+    def wait(self, seconds=0.5, label="watch"):
+        self.step += 1
+        result = self.r.get_obs(cameras=self.cam_names, seconds=seconds,
+                                include_depth=True, video="frames", video_fps=5)
+        result.save(str(self.out / f"{label}_{self.step:03d}"))
+        self.obs = result
+        self.command = np.asarray(result.meta["proprio"]["now"][80:104], dtype=np.float64)
+        return result
+
+    def status(self):
+        return self.r.status()
+
+
+def main():
+    """Standalone entry point; do not call if a client is already connected."""
+    from rcb_client import Robot
+    r = Robot()
+    c = Controller(r, r.spec())
+    print(json.dumps(c.obs.meta, indent=2))
+    print("Controller connected. Inspect the saved observation, then call staged moves.")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
